algorithm: Full copy with SHA-256 manifest, then re-hash verification

classes.desc: Copies a source tree to a destination and verifies it with SHA-256 checksums.
classes.name: BackupJob

complexity: O(bytes) to copy and hash every file
data_flow_ascii:
demo_workspace/source -> BackupJob.collect -> file list
copy2 per file + SHA-256 -> demo_workspace/backup + manifest.json
BackupJob.verify -> re-hash backup -> compare manifest -> OK/FAILED
description_sentence: A backup tool that copies a folder, records SHA-256 checksums in a JSON manifest, and verifies the backup by re-hashing.
failure_note: verify() reports exactly which files mismatch instead of failing silently; a failed verify returns exit code 1.

functions.desc: Relative paths of every file under the source, sorted.
functions.name: BackupJob.collect

functions.desc: Copy every file, write a JSON manifest of SHA-256 checksums.
functions.name: BackupJob.run

functions.desc: Re-hash every backed-up file and compare against the manifest.
functions.name: BackupJob.verify

functions.desc: Create n seeded text and binary files under source; return rel paths.
functions.name: make_sample_files
functions.signature: make_sample_files(source: str, n: int, rng: random.Random) -> list

functions.desc: Generate sample files, back them up with checksums, then verify.
functions.name: run_demo
functions.signature: run_demo(seed: int, n_files: int, chunk_kb: int) -> int

functions.desc: Build the command-line parser for the demo.
functions.name: build_parser

functions.desc: Parse flags and run the backup demo.
functions.name: main

label: backup tool
output_shape: Prints a per-file table (name, bytes, checksum prefix), the manifest path, and the verify result (N/N OK).
pitch_sentence: I built a {topic} that copies your files and proves the copy is exact by verifying SHA-256 checksums.

qa.a: After copying, run() hashes each destination file and writes path, size, and SHA-256 into backup/manifest.json.
verify() re-hashes every file in the backup and compares against the manifest, reporting ok and failed lists.
shutil.copy2 preserves file metadata like modification times along with the content.

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} in Python that copies a folder tree and verifies integrity with SHA-256 checksums stored in a JSON manifest.
run_notes: --files and --chunk-kb tune the demo. Source and backup live inside ./demo_workspace.
scaling_note: Single-machine full copies; large trees would want incremental backups and parallel hashing.
storage_note: The backup folder and manifest.json persist inside ./demo_workspace until the next demo run wipes them.
tech_stack: stdlib: argparse, hashlib, json, os, random, shutil
tradeoff_note: Full copies are simple and robust but wasteful for large trees; incremental backups would add real complexity.
